degree_rationale: Five Mysteries/Garments by which the First Man clothed himself — Calling joining Answer, twenty characters, twenty members; the fifty days of fasting; until Jesus the Radiance came. Treats the natural-ecclesiastical reception of mysteries.
direction_rationale: Inward receiving of fasting-and-mystery cycles — the Pentecost as inner reception of ascending light. Reflective ritual reception.
grand_man_function: Natural mystery-reception — the fasting cycle of soul-ascending.
title: The Five Mysteries / Garments by which the First Man clothed himself
